column5: \textbf{Description}
Reception of DEM events which are routed from SUM_ERRH to the SUM_SOH for processing.
Permit Execution interface to indicate that operating conditions are correct for the SUM_SOH to execute its functions.
Notification to the SUM_SOH of any active or not active partial networks.
Notification of MAC failures along with their types.
Notification of a service 0x11 tester-initiated request for ECU Reset (not programming).
Notification to the SUM_SOH that a reset occurred. The type of reset is also communicated to the SUM_SOH. Type of resets may be delayed or immediate.
Notification to the SUM_SOH that a service 0x04 or a service 0x14 request was accepted or rejected.
Notification to the SUM_SOH that a reprogramming request took place (service 0x10 subfunction 0x02).
Notification to the SUM_SOH of the occurrences of service 0x27 failures.
Notification to the SUM_SOH from SUM_SUSD that vehicle battery voltage is too low to perform NVM writes.
This interface is used by the SUM_DIAG to communicate to SUM_SOH to value of the MEC.
To support the collection of Diagnostic DIDs that are part of the SUM_SOH functionalities.
Notification of a request to shutdown to reset as part of programming to jump to boot.

Notification of WdgM local supervision failures occurrence for all supervised entities excluding the SUM_SOH and the SUM_ERRH.\newline \footnotesize{These interfaces replace the SOH_BswM_WdgM _IndividualMode<1...n> interfaces described in GB8002.}
Notification of the WdgM SUM_ERRH local supervision failures occurrences. \newline \footnotesize{This interface replaces the SOH_BsWM_WdgM _ERRHMode interface described in GB8002.}
This interface is used by the BswM to notify SUM_SOH of SecP errors occurrences.
The interface provides services for the management and maintenance of NV data related to SOH Metrics.
The interface provides services for the clear of the SOH Metrics.
Notify the checkpoint reachement for implementing the Local Supervision.
The interface provides service for starting clear, all the metrics related to SUM_SOH Local Supervision Detector implemented at ERRH side.
Shutdown Permission interface to indicate that operating conditions are correct for the SUM_SOH to execute the shutdown.
